title: The small strict-local model as a compatible section cone
statement: For a geometric point s:Spec(Omega) -> S, use the specified small pointed-affine coordinate-ring colimit scheme T=strictHenselizationScheme s, its structural map g, and the initial representative pointed-neighbourhood functor N. For every representative j, the map to the base change of N(j) has first projection the canonical limit leg followed by the affine-spectrum identification, and second projection the identity of T. These sections commute with every pointed transition. Consequently they define a PointedEtaleSectionCone g N; the general restriction and uniqueness constructions apply to this actual small-colimit scheme.

proof.text: For each j take the pullback lift of the limit leg followed by the affine-spectrum comparison and the identity map. The representative structural-map equation proves the pullback equation.

Initiality is strictHenselization_properties. Prove naturality of these sections by pullback.hom_ext: the second projection is the identity, while the first follows from the limit-cone naturality equation and Scheme.isoSpec_inv_naturality. This supplies the general cone data.
